## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For live UI changes, include PME, host app,
and macOS versions, plus a sanitized screenshot or recording when useful.
State any checks not run or remaining compatibility limits.

## Documentation

Note any user-facing or contributor instructions updated for this change.
Do not attach private logs, message captures, account identifiers, or credentials.
